'''2008 Worlds Day 1 Jim Radloff DS Set Your Course For Alderaan (V)''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Jim Radloff]] at [[2008 World Championship]] (Day 1). Sheet title Boom ball '08.


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Jim Radloff]]
* '''Event:''' [[2008 World Championship]]
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS16]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' [[Set Your Course For Alderaan (V)]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
